title: Soldiers and officers confirm the giant story to Alberino
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Soldiers and officers confirm the giant story to Alberino, about recent years at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I've interacted with a handful of people um some soldiers, others officers that have confirmed to me that a that story is true and b there are even wilder stories and there are more giants out there than just one obviously.

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino, who tells of a 12 foot giant said to have been captured in Afghanistan, says a handful of soldiers and officers have told him that the story is true. According to Alberino, they also said there are even wilder stories and more giants out there than just one. If true, it would mean the military knows of living giants.
